content:
Hi

Your screen shot shows none of the special folders (archive, draft, trash etc.) have IMAP folders names assigned. I suspect the account setup is incomplete and has never signed into the server. The app gets a list of imap folders when it first signs into the server.

Did you by an chance import accounts from Thunderbird desktop and press the "later" button, skipping account sign-in. See screen shot.

Until sign-in is completed, an account will display only an outbox folder. This could be one reason why outbox is being selected and no other folders are displayed in the auto-select folder list.

Could you confirm this by checking if the normal list of imap folders such as Inbox, Sent Mail, Draft, Spam & Trash are listed in the account.

If your unfamiliar,

  1. Tap the ≡ menu button at the top left of screen.
  2. Press the down arrow.
  3. Tap the account name associated with the outbox.

Do you see only outbox?

If confirmed, you can either complete the account sign-in steps or remove it from the app.

To complete the sign-in steps ...

  1. Navigate to settings > account name > fetching mail > incoming server.
  2. Enter the password if empty
  3. Tap next.
  4. If prompted to sign-in to your provider, press the sign in button and complete the steps.
  5. Navigate to settings > account name > sending mail > outgoing server.
  6. Press next.

Once successfully completed, the account should then display a list of all folders. See example screen shot.

To remove an account ...

  1. Navigate to settings > account name.
  2. Tap the three dot menu ፧ at the top left of screen.
  3. Tap remove account.

Hi seraphir

Adjustment of font size within the app is not currently available however you can increase the size via Androids system wide font settings.

Developers have stated in the below github comment. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues/9709#issuecomment-3249281014

We’ve removed these settings as part of the ongoing UI redesign, since the previous way of changing font sizes no longer works with the new design system. We’re working on alternative options to bring back some customization in a future update.

You can show your interest in the feature by raising it on Mozilla connect. It's then open to community votes.
